title: Mallworld bathroom
content: I'm so happy to have found this sub. I never realized there were others out there who have these dreams. My recurring mallworld theme involves a spherical mall in space with a river running through it. I always seem to end up in a bathroom, in what seems to be a fast food restaurant. There is always a humanoid figure with no facial features except for a mouth, laying in the sink dead. I always go and alert the staff about this, and the response is always "No need to worry sir, that's just the machine." I then tell them I think it's dead, and they respond with "it's not dead. The machine can never die" I then leave the restaurant and walk by the river, and notice the machine following me. Often I wake up at this point, or lose sight of it, but a few times it has caught up to me. When it does, it proceeds to start eating my stomach, and I can usually feel discomfort, but cannot move. I do have other dreams in the same world but this scenario happens more often than others.
